statement: Acceptance obligations: The host ledger implements the persistent-active scheduling foundation in [distant-world.md](distant-world.md). / It is gated by the existing `sim.active_regions` switch, enabled in compiled and packaged defaults for v0.3.0. / Budgets remain unlimited in shipped configuration. / Existing field pages, weather, scent and energy consume regional scheduling; / automatic ambient-page activation and complete field qualification remain release work. / The continuation and qualification work for durable completed work and ground objects, regional fields/weather/scent/energy, regional foliage/water (issue #242), and strict distant policy and distant creatures is carried by v0.3.2 (in preparation). / Regional continuation performance/default enablement is planned for v0.4.0 as [issue #320](https://github.com/d-addison/luminumbra/issues/320). / Implemented consumers do not establish native verification or release qualification. / The dedicated server autosaves every five minutes; / issue #136 still requires paired flag-state oracle artifacts and a 20 km activation/freezing run log.
